Mahayana Portal

Mahayana (महायान, mahāyāna) is a major branch of Buddhism focusing on the path of a Bodhisattva (spiritual aspirants/ enlightened beings). Extant literature is vast and primarely composed in the Sanskrit language. There are many 
sūtras
 of which some of the earliest are the various Prajñāpāramitā sūtras.
